arguments.description: Select an absolute UTF-8 .txt or .md objective file with the file button. Its content is loaded by the release 3 objective-loader tool.
arguments.name: training_objective_file

description: Train the configured model adapter from a simple objective: retrieve matching RAG documents, generate fresh JSONL data, run smoke, and continue only on PASS.
name: finetune_training_cycle
template:
Complete training workflow input. Copy every line between `<workflow_input>` and `</workflow_input>` unchanged into `run_workflow.user_prompt`; do not shorten it to the workflow name or omit any field.

<workflow_input>
Project root: `${CHAT_PROJECT_DIR}`
Training configuration (absolute): `${CHAT_PROJECT_DIR}/config/mcpstudio-v3.toml`
Training objective file: {{training_objective_file}}

Load and validate the selected objective file before document discovery. The inline objective is only a fallback when no file is supplied by a direct non-picker invocation. Build a generic source plan with requiredSubjects, a runtime-derived contentScope, and exact sources containing path, subjects, evidence and any required deterministic contentRules. Keep all product and domain facts in runtime input, the generated run policy and selected documents. Require deterministic hash deduplication, content filtering, source and subject balancing, and independent train/validation coverage. Run smoke first, then full training only on PASS. Python owns metrics, early stopping and best-checkpoint selection. Do not merge, verify, install or deploy.
</workflow_input>
